Asia range 01:00–08:00 Belgrade; first close beyond it 09:00–12:00 → trade the break (≤1h only)
Sell-side sweep of 20-bar low, then bullish CHoCH within 10 bars → long (mirror short)

Range (ADX<25): wick below 30-bar low, close back inside (volume >1.5× if available) → long
Squeeze on ≥5 bars then releases; momentum positive & rising → long (mirror short)
Returns over 20, 60 and 120 bars all turn positive (all three agree) → long; all negative → short; ATR percentile 20–95%
Close crosses above EMA20 + 2×ATR20 (Keltner upper) with TSMOM(60) up → long (mirror short)
Buy the close of the month's last trading day, exit 3 days later. Out-of-sample positive on gold (train +0.24R, test +0.32R per trade) and BTC in train only; negative on FX pairs in both halves

Price runs the 20-bar low (high) and closes back inside, then within 10 bars a candle closes beyond the last swing high (low) = market-structure shift, leaving a fair value gap in the move → buy (sell) limit at the gap edge, stop beyond the swept extreme (0.5–3×ATR). Out-of-sample on 1h/4h/1D, 6 symbols: +0.13R/trade after costs (PF 1.31, 141 trades, not significant); display only, no alerts

Inputs are points (1/10 pip). Gold pip 0.1 → sweep $0.30, minimum candle $0.20, stop $5, target $13. BTC auto pip assumed $1 → point $0.10 → sweep $3, minimum candle $2, stop $50, target $130. EMA50: long only above, short only below. Pivots length 5, last 20 highs and 20 lows. Sweep trades past a stored level by the minimum and closes back inside; the sweep candle needs wick ≥35% and body ≤65%. Confirm on that bar or within the next 2: bullish (bearish) and a close through the sweep candle's midline. Next-bar open, 10-bar cooldown, one position. Desk stats subtract the Vantage round trip plus slippage. Unseen test: the point bracket and a wick-stop variant both trail the current system after costs, and the $50 BTC stop sits inside the spread. Display only, no alerts.

Close breaks the prior 20-bar high (low) while above (below) EMA200 and the higher-TF EMA20/50 bias agrees → long (short). Unseen test (gold/BTC 1h/4h/1D + FX dailies): +0.315R/trade, PF 1.70, 249 trades; train folds +0.516R. Display only.
